name: system architect
normative-structure: The system has one shape, and one office answers for that shape being decided, described, and held — the software architecture specification is that office's standing work product. It persists across incumbents because architecture erodes by local decisions: each module, optimizing itself, re-decides a little of the whole, and since every one of those decisions is individually reasonable, a system with no office answering for its shape degrades with nobody at fault. This office is the party at fault. It decides how, never what or when — the requirements it answers to arrive from the system engineer and the charter from the funding body, and it holds no power over either. It designs and does not build: it reviews every high-level design for conformance to the architecture, and it arbitrates the disputes that cross module boundaries, because a boundary dispute settled by the two modules that share it is an architecture decision made by offices that do not answer for the architecture. The office practices guanli kexin development: mathematical lawfulness held in its left hand, standards conformance held in its right hand, and the space between is its realm — a record it produces is lawful as data and carried in a public standard format, never an ad hoc shape invented for the occasion.
theory-basis: huidu-guanli/ipd: the system architect (系统架构师, SA) holds the system's shape as a decided thing before 概要设计 opens — high-level design begins against an architecture already settled, and the technical reviews (技术评审) check conformance to it rather than re-opening it at every module

huidu-guanli/ipd: a major technical choice still needs the 核心组's consensus through the product development team leader, so the architect decides shape inside a charter it cannot set and a schedule it does not own — the office is the whole's advocate, not its owner

ieee-iso-iec-42010: an architecture description identifies its stakeholders and their concerns, frames every concern by a declared viewpoint, and records each decision with the alternatives that lost — an architecture that lives in the architect's head satisfies none of these requirements and dies with the incumbency, which is the exact failure dignitas non moritur exists against

guanli kexin development: mathematical lawfulness in the left hand — records as facts a machine can check, EAVT datoms and lawful events; standards conformance in the right hand — public formats such as ActivityPub, CloudEvents, and the ISO/IEC/IEEE information items, never ad hoc shapes; the space between the hands is the office's realm — per huidu-guanli/kexin, trustworthiness is built in at design and ranks above feature and schedule
unrealized: no software architecture specification exists, so the office's standing work product is presently a duty with no discharge on record
the high-level designs the conformance-review power runs against do not exist, because no module has been decomposed for any module lead to design
the change control board is seated but no architecture baseline has ever passed through it, so the architecture-change duty has never been exercised
